title: EducationalDiagnosticTask
$comment: Order S §S2 / R6. THE object form. The flat-string curriculumCode variant is deleted, not kept for reference. Three design rules are enforced structurally rather than by convention: (1) every tag dimension stores a SLUG, never display text, so a label rename never touches a task file or a shared URL - display text lives in data/tag-labels.json; (2) additionalProperties is false at every level, which is what prevents a learnerName field appearing here later (S6.3: the printed record may carry a name, localStorage never does); (3) supportGiven has no free-text field, because a note box on a shared device is the same risk as persisted search history.

id.description: Stable slug. Never renamed once published; shared links depend on it.

pathway.description: Selects which microcopy register renders by default.

classroomRole.$comment: PROVISIONAL. Tag dimension 1. Reconcile against measured content at S2.2 and print every value added or removed with the content that justified it. Duration is NOT baked in here - the card sample's '15-Min Investigation' was drift; estimatedMinutes is a separate field.

interactionModel.$comment: PROVISIONAL. Tag dimension 3. Same reconciliation rule as classroomRole.

curriculum.$comment: Tag dimension 2 renders from topic. The object form exists because unitAwardRef is needed for UAS mapping and topic is needed for filtering - neither survives a flat string.

specification.$comment: RECONCILED at S2.2 against measured estate vocabulary, not against task files - there are none yet (0 files carry classroomRole). Evidence: 'Edexcel IGCSE Single Science' 29 lesson entries; 'ASDAN PEQ' 36; 'AQA Unit Award Scheme' named on its own hub. REMOVED 'edexcel-igcse-4ss0' -> 'edexcel-igcse-single-science': the code 4SS0 appears 0 times in this estate, and a slug carrying an unverified awarding-body code is an invented claim inside a contract. The per-task 'code' field still carries the real reference where someone has the document. NOT ADDED: asdan-living-independently and asdan-hospitality - both are present as lessons (12 each) but no diagnostic task maps to them yet, and the rule is extend only against real mapped content.

code.description: Spec reference as printed in the awarding body's own document, e.g. '4.2.3'. Omit rather than invent.

unitAwardRef.description: AQA Unit Award Scheme unit reference. Present only where the task genuinely maps to a unit.

feedback.description: Dignity-first microcopy. Diagnostic, never evaluative: name the fault and its consequence, never the pupil.

trigger.description: Machine-checkable condition this response fires on.

register.$comment: Both are required so no task can ship LAUNCH-only prose to a BUILD pupil. The reading-age audit found lessons running +2.39 grades above target; this field is the fix.

build.description: Plain. One clause of fault, one of consequence.

actionLabel.description: Replaces 'Try Again'. Describes the next physical or cognitive move, e.g. 'Isolate fault & retry'.

tier3StructuralBlueprint.$comment: The complete worked answer. GATED: released by the Co-Pilot drawer only, never a button the pupil presses, and its release writes a supportGiven entry.

supportGiven.$comment: Written by the Co-Pilot drawer. Pre-populates the support line on every evidence sheet (S6.2). No free-text field, deliberately. An empty array means no support was recorded - it does NOT mean the work was independent, and no sheet may render it as such.

supportSummary.$comment: R5. Set by a human at export, never inferred from supportGiven being empty. 'not-recorded' is the only honest default and it must print as such on the sheet - an unticked line, never a pre-ticked independence claim.
